items.headline: Kinetiq Opens Elysium Testnet for Hyperliquid DeFi
items.summary: Liquid staking protocol Kinetiq launched the Elysium testnet, an Arbitrum Orbit chain built for Hyperliquid-focused DeFi apps, citing HyperEVM throughput limits. $KNTQ ecosystem expansion is one to watch.

items.headline: $NEAR Adds Ondo Tokenized Stocks With Private Execution
items.summary: near.com now offers Ondo Finance's tokenized US stocks and ETFs, purchasable with crypto across 30+ networks with confidential trade execution. A big RWA win for $NEAR.

items.headline: CME to List $UNI and Bitcoin Cash Futures Oct. 19
items.summary: CME Group will launch standard and Micro futures for $UNI and BCH, expanding its single-token crypto lineup to eleven. Institutional derivatives access could boost $UNI liquidity.

items.headline: $SEI Giga Test Hits 63,200 Requests Per Second
items.summary: Sei Giga completed its first full test, processing 63,200 requests per second. The throughput milestone strengthens the $SEI case as a high-performance trading chain.

items.headline: $STRK Unveils Proof of Privacy Initiative, Demo Day
items.summary: Starknet announced its Proof of Privacy initiative and its first cohort demo day, pushing privacy-focused development on the L2. A fresh narrative catalyst for $STRK.
